name: Thigh-high socks (femboy style)

card.summary: Over-the-knee socks worn in femboy styling to frame the legs and add a defined line between hemline and thigh.
card.note: A clothing choice with no health risks beyond fit; elastic bands that are too tight can be uncomfortable.

quick.overview:
Thigh-high socks are a staple of femboy styling, the online aesthetic in which men and boys express themselves through traditionally feminine clothing such as skirts, dresses and thigh-high socks. They are worn to emphasize leg shape and to complete a skirt-and-sock outfit.

The look overlaps with the Japanese zettai ryoiki concept, the strip of bare thigh between sock top and skirt, which fan communities describe with proportion ratios. Both come from anime and fashion rather than from formal style research.
quick.how: People pair thigh-highs with skirts, shorts or dresses, choosing sock length, colour and fabric to set the proportions of the outfit. Some wearers also describe them as comfortable loungewear.
quick.risks: Few physical risks; poorly fitting tops can roll or constrict. Socially, femboy styling can attract commentary, positive and negative, depending on setting.

lead: Thigh-high socks are knit socks that reach the upper thigh, and are a common garment in femboy styling. Femboy is a slang term, usually for a male who expresses himself through traditionally feminine traits; its clothing vocabulary includes skirts, dresses and thigh-high socks, along with jewellery, makeup and hair dye.[1]

For appearance, the socks cover the leg and set a hem line partway up the thigh, which defines leg shape and the proportion of skirt, bare skin and sock. Japanese fan culture names the exposed strip zettai ryoiki, meaning absolute territory, and describes a proportion of 4:1:2.5 for skirt length, exposed thigh and sock, with some 25% tolerance.[2]

The femboy term appeared mostly on 4chan around 2018 and spread to Reddit and TikTok, with hashtags such as #FemboyFriday helping popularise the aesthetic.[1] No fashion research specific to thigh-high socks on men has been published.

chain: Wear thigh-high socks with a skirt or shorts
Sock top forms a defined line on the thigh
Accented leg shape and feminine-leaning silhouette
angle.text: The socks visually frame the legs, and the proportion between hem, bare thigh and sock top is the main styling variable. They are one piece of a broader femboy wardrobe.

paras: Thigh-highs are named in descriptions of the femboy look as one of the signature garments, alongside skirts and dresses.[1] The term femboy describes gender expression rather than orientation or identity.[1]

The Japanese term zettai ryoiki originated in otaku slang around anime and manga, tracing to Neon Genesis Evangelion (1995), and entered general Japanese use; it now covers thigh highs, knee highs, stockings and shorts.[2] Fans describe a 4:1:2.5 ratio and grade outfits from E to A.[2]
Femboy content moved from 4chan's /lgbt/ board around 2018 to Reddit, where r/feminineboys, founded in 2012, had about 303,000 members by May 2025, and to TikTok.[1]

timeline.event: Neon Genesis Evangelion, source of the zettai ryoiki term.[2]
Media coverage of femboy TikTok trends begins.[1]
